items.wrong: It was design by a Danish man.
items.fix: It was designed by a Danish man.

items.why: In questions, was goes before it.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: The bridge built in 1932. → The bridge was built in 1932. | It was design by a Danish man. → It was designed by a Danish man. | Who it was built by? → Who was it built by?.
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

errors.w: It was design by a Danish man.
errors.r: It was designed by a Danish man.

facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Afirmativa: The bridge was built in 1932. Pergunta: Who was it designed by? Negativa: It wasn’t finished quickly. Use was no singular e were no plural.

facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Para dizer que algo foi feito, use was/were + particípio: The bridge was built in 1932. O foco está no objeto, não em quem fez. Use was no singular e were no plural.

facts.label: Por quem
facts.sub: Use by para dizer quem fez: It was designed by a Danish man. Se não importa quem fez, ou ninguém sabe, deixe o by de fora: The bridge was painted grey.

facts.label: Perguntas
facts.sub: Para perguntar, coloque was/were antes do sujeito: When was it opened? Who was it designed by? Para sim ou não: Was it finished quickly? A resposta curta é Yes, it was ou No, it wasn’t.

facts.label: Negativa
facts.sub: Para negar, use wasn’t/weren’t + particípio: It wasn’t finished quickly. The photos weren’t taken here. Cuidado com o particípio: build vira built.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “A ponte foi construída em 1932”, com ser + particípio.
compare.us: Em inglês: was/were + particípio. A ponte foi construída em 1932 vira The bridge was built in 1932. Para o agente, use by.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The past passive is was/were + past participle.
“It was designed by an architect” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The past passive is was/were + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The bridge built in 1932”. → Falso (We say was built.)
“It was designed by an architect” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
